title: 第一卷 第1章 系统绑定，多子多福！
slug: 开局自曝系统家族助我娶妻成仙
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“姜无痕，你一个无法修炼的废物，有什么资格迎娶我？”

“我林晶晶，就算是死，也不会嫁给你这个姜家纨绔！”

劈头盖脸的骂声在耳畔响彻，姜无痕眸光微动，眼神中恢复了一丝清澈。

他环顾四周，帝子殿外，处处张灯结彩，宾客满座。

而在这喜庆的氛围下，面前的少女一把扯下红盖头，美眸中满是蔑视与冷漠。

姜无痕心头一惊，这是……穿越了？

下一刻，大量本不属于他的记忆涌入脑海——

阎浮大世界，不朽帝族，姜家帝子……

这是个以武为尊的大千世界，强者可破碎虚空，毁天灭地！

姜无痕，出身帝族姜家，有大帝坐镇的人族巅峰势力之一。

父亲是当世大帝，母亲是准帝巅峰，身份何其尊贵！

然而，作为他们的唯一子嗣，姜无痕却是个不折不扣的修炼废柴。

任凭姜家在他倾注无数心血，都无法改变他无法修炼的事实。

姜族帝子，是个凡人！

不仅如此，姜无痕不求上进，倾心于林家这个没落世家的嫡女——林晶晶，为爱甘做舔狗。

三年以来，追求林晶晶送上的资源，生生将林家从三流势力堆成了一流世家。

今日，便是在双方长辈的施压下，举办的成亲大典！

姜无痕消化着脑海中的记忆，看着面前当众羞辱自己的少女，脸色阴沉下来。

这身份，这背景，去当舔狗？

花三亿灵石去泡一个没落世家的妞，还泡不到！

同时，姜无痕心底升起一股无力感。

在这遍地强者的世界，自己一个无法修炼的凡人，就算娶到天骄圣女，都不一定破的了人家的防！

除了弄人家一身口水，还能干什么？

就在姜无痕心灰意冷之际，一道机械的电子音在他耳畔响起——

【叮咚，检测到宿主已穿越，多子多福系统绑定成功！】

【本系统致力于帮助宿主广结良缘，繁育子嗣，为家族开枝散叶！】

【宿主与拥有特殊体质，且评分在90分以上的女修结合，诞下天赋强悍的后代，皆可获得丰厚奖励，包括但不限于：无上修为、超绝天赋、造化仙丹、极道帝兵、仙阶功法等。】

【新手大礼包发放，是否

一瞬间，姜无痕眼前一亮。

就仿佛无能的丈夫，在绝望中看到了一碗鹿血！

【恭喜宿主获得万道欲仙圣体，玉髓化龙丹，《阴阳补天术》】

【万道欲仙圣体：极品圣体，虽无战力加成，却能极大提升某方面的能力，并增加与异性诞下后代的几率，强化后代体质！】

【玉髓化龙丹：造化仙丹，凡人服用，亦可拥有盖世天资！】

【阴阳补天术：仙阶功法，阴阳同补，双修时，双方皆可获得莫大好处！】

这时，林晶晶见姜无痕不语，当即呵斥道：“姜无痕，我在跟你说话，你没听到吗？”

“闭嘴，婊/子！”

姜无痕冷声怒斥，同时目光从她身上扫过，一道信息面板浮现——

"Jiang Wuhen, you are a useless person who cannot cultivate, what qualifications do you have to marry me?"

"I, Lin Jingjing, even if I die, will not marry you, a Dandy from the Jiang family!"

The shouting curses rang in his ears, Jiang Wuhen's eyes moved slightly, and a trace of clarity returned to his eyes.

He looked around. Outside the Emperor's Palace, there were lights and colorful lights everywhere, and the seats were full of guests.

And in this festive atmosphere, the girl in front of her pulled off her red hijab, her beautiful eyes full of contempt and indifference.

Jiang Wuhen was shocked. Was this... traveling through time?

The next moment, a large number of memories that did not belong to him poured into his mind——

The Great World of Jamfu, the Immortal Imperial Clan, the Emperor's Son of the Jiang Family...

This is a vast world where martial arts is respected. A strong man can shatter the void and destroy the heaven and the earth!

Jiang Wuhen was born in the Jiang family of the imperial clan, and was one of the top forces of the human race with the Great Emperor at his command.

My father is the great emperor of the world, and my mother is the pinnacle of quasi-emperors. How noble is her status!

However, as their only heir, Jiang Wuhen was an out-and-out useless practitioner.

No matter how much effort the Jiang family put into him, they could not change the fact that he was unable to practice.

The emperor of the Jiang clan is a mortal!

Not only that, Jiang Wuhen did not seek advancement, and fell in love with Lin Jingjing, the legitimate daughter of the declining family, and was willing to be a licking dog for her love.

In the past three years, pursuing the resources provided by Lin Jingjing has transformed the Lin family from a third-rate force into a first-rate family.

Today is the wedding ceremony held under pressure from the elders of both parties!

Jiang Wuhen digested the memories in his mind and looked at the girl in front of him who humiliated him in public, his face darkened.

With this identity and background, do you want to be a bitch?

I spent 300 million spiritual stones to pick up a girl from a declining family, but I still can’t get it!

At the same time, Jiang Wuhen felt a sense of powerlessness in his heart.

In this world full of strong men, as a mortal who cannot cultivate, even if he marries a genius saint, he may not be able to break their defenses!

What else can you do besides making people drool all over you?

Just when Jiang Wuhen was feeling discouraged, a mechanical electronic sound sounded in his ears——

[Ding dong, it is detected that the host has traveled through time, and the Duoziduofu system is successfully bound!】

[This system is dedicated to helping the host form a good relationship, breed heirs, and flourish the family!】

[The host combines with a female cultivator with a special physique and a score of 90 or above, and gives birth to offspring with strong talents. All of them can receive generous rewards, including but not limited to: supreme cultivation, extraordinary talents, good fortune elixirs, extremely powerful emperor weapons, immortal-level skills, etc.】

[Gift package for newbies is distributed, whether

In an instant, Jiang Wuhen's eyes lit up.

It was as if the incompetent husband saw a bowl of deer blood in despair!

[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Holy Body of Ten Thousand Paths of Desire, the Chalcedony Dragon Transformation Pill, and the "Yin-Yang Heaven-Mending Technique"]

[The Sacred Body of Ten Thousand Paths of Desire: The ultimate holy body, although it has no combat power bonus, it can greatly improve certain abilities, increase the chance of having offspring with the opposite sex, and strengthen the physique of the offspring!】

[Chalcedony Dragon Transformation Pill: The elixir of good fortune. Even ordinary people who take it can have unparalleled talents!】

[Yin-Yang Heaven-Building Technique: Immortal-level technique, Yin-Yang nourishes the sky at the same time. When practicing both, both parties can gain great benefits!】

At this time, Lin Jingjing saw that Jiang Wuhen was silent and immediately scolded: "Jiang Wuhen, I'm talking to you, didn't you hear me?"

"Shut up, bitch!"

Jiang Wuhen scolded her coldly, and at the same time his eyes swept over her body, and an information panel appeared——
